title: A plugin watchdog
description:
Keep plugins in their own processes and restart one that stops answering.

```
plugin "spell" heartbeat at 0, 1, 2
plugin "ai" last heartbeat at 1
t=4.5: "ai" silent for 3.5 s -> killed, restarting
t=5: "spell" fine
```
hints: A restart sets `lastHeartbeat = now`, giving the new process time to start (lesson 6.03).
Return the actions as strings so they are easy to print and to test.
requirements: Each plugin sends a heartbeat; the host records the last time it heard from each.
`tick(now)` kills and restarts plugins silent for more than 3 seconds.
A plugin restarted 3 times is disabled, and the host carries on without it.
stretch: Put each plugin process in a job object so killing the host also kills them.
